Millimetres.description: A length or a coordinate, in whole millimetres (1 m = 1000).

SitGroupKey.description: The furniture a sit point belongs to, so that a depiction and a word can name it once: the `window-bench` of `window-bench.1` and `window-bench.2`.

SitPoint.description: One place where one person may sit, on free floor.

at.description: The seated person's position on the place's floor, in millimetres.

facing.description: The yaw a seated person faces, in millidegrees: `0` faces north, `90 000` east, `180 000` south.

group.description: The furniture this point belongs to, if any: a slug such as `window-bench`.

key.description: The point's name, unique within its place: 1 to 48 bytes of `a`–`z`, `0`–`9`, `-` and `.`.

SitPointKey.description: The name of a sit point, unique within its place: `window-bench.1`, `pier-bench.2`.

Spot.description: The position of a sit point, as a file writes it: `{ x: 2700, y: 1160 }`.

x.description: Millimetres east of the place's origin.

y.description: Millimetres north of the place's origin.

description: The sit points of one place: at most [`SIT_POINTS_MAX`], keys unique, every pair at least [`SIT_POINT_SPACING`] apart, held sorted by key (`ARC-147`, I-a-2).
